name: myotatic crunch on bosu ball
description: A deep, stretched crunch over a Bosu ball. The extra range loads the abs strongly.
instructions: Lie back over a Bosu ball with your lower back supported.
Place your hands beside your head and your feet flat.
Let your torso extend gently over the ball.
Crunch up, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Lower slowly through the full range.
